verdict.rationale: Daytona publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at /openapi.json and SDK reference docs with copy-pasteable code examples such as `daytona.create()` and `sandbox.process.exec()`. An agent skill also bundles references for the Daytona API. However, nothing shows an interactive API explorer where requests can be run from the docs. Missing for 10: an interactive API reference UI (try-it/playground), runnable-in-browser examples, and hands-on or independent corroboration of the API reference experience.
